cases.name: ammonia_inversion
cases.coordinate: Umbrella: N mirrored through the H3 plane (+d0 -> planar -> -d0)

backend_notes.uff: excluded: UFF inversion term far too stiff on the rigid path (10.9 vs 5.79); a relaxed path needs a method-specific optimizer

method_notes: Rigid scans (exact-symmetry endpoints): methyl torsions rotate one top by 0..120 deg in 20-deg steps; ammonia translates N between exact mirror images (planar midpoint sampled).
Rigid profiles are upper bounds to the relaxed MEP; endpoints are seed-42 embeddings (method-agnostic).
The legacy PM3 NEB backend is excluded: it uses the unvalidated legacy PM3 engine, not the faithful F42 port.
Simplified Cartesian NEB is unsuitable for >30 deg torsions (chord collapse) and collapses with over-relaxation; the experimental CI-NEB diverged on these paths. Documented, not used for numbers.
